independenceNote: Robonine sells the SO-ARM102 kit ($389) built on STS3215 and STS3250 servos.

source.title: Robonine: Testing of Feetech STS3215 Servomotor: Backlash, Repeatability, and Torque

rig.encoder: Dial indicator on an 86 mm lever, about 30 g rubber-band preload

claims.source: Feetech datasheet <= 0.5 deg as quoted by Robonine; Feetech primary not verified

notes: Angular backlash of 0.0151 rad (about 0.87 deg). The servo's firmware has a 10-count dead zone (about 0.88 deg), nearly equal to the measured play, so much of it may be control dead band rather than gears.
